name: Kawasaki Eliminator (2024-on)
engine: 451 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: Kawasaki's modern small cruiser, built on the Ninja 500 engine.

A: In the US the 2024 Ninja 500 and Z500 had a clutch release shaft recall (25V146). The Eliminator was included in Canada. Run your VIN to be sure.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Clutch release shaft
known.what: In Canada, 2024 Eliminator 500 bikes were recalled because the clutch lever could break. The US recall listed the Ninja 500 and Z500.
